description: The INFORMATION_SCHEMA table functions, and the two ways Frostlake used to be more permissive than the account. They exist ONLY under INFORMATION_SCHEMA, so the bare name resolves to nothing - Frostlake resolved a qualified name by its last part and so never noticed the qualifier was missing - while both qualified spellings, schema-only and database-qualified, run. And their leading POSITIONAL parameter is a TIME-RANGE BOUND, not a result limit: QUERY_HISTORY(2) blames 'END_TIME_RANGE_START' where Frostlake read the 2 as a row cap and answered rows. That parameter is named in the refusal rather than reported by position, unlike FLATTEN or SPLIT_TO_TABLE whose positional parameters are '1' and '2', and a date-shaped STRING is refused too since there is no implicit conversion here. Converted 1:1 from functions/HistoryTableFunctionArgumentTest (now retired).
